turns.q: Hi, I have a specific need and I'm worried about picking the wrong thing. Can you help?
turns.replyTail:
What are you looking for specifically? For example, are you choosing:

A rose for a certain spot (full sun, part shade, pot, etc.)
Something for a particular hardiness zone or climate
A plant for a special purpose (cut flowers, fragrance, covering a fence, low maintenance, etc.)

If you can also tell me your ZIP code or hardiness zone and what you’re hoping this plant will do for you, I can narrow it down and make some clear suggestions so you don’t end up with the wrong thing.

A quick bit about how our plants differ from a lot of others out there:

Roses are backed by a one‑year guarantee, and perennials by a 90‑day guarantee, so we stand behind how they perform.
